# dbt-charts

> A lightweight dashboard layer for analytics engineers.

dbt-charts helps analytics engineers generate static dashboards from dbt projects.
It uses .ggsql chart files, dashboard YAML, dbt artifacts, DuckDB execution, and static HTML export.

- Overview: https://dbtcharts.pages.dev/docs/intro
- Quickstart: https://dbtcharts.pages.dev/docs/get-started/quickstart

- Dashboard YAML: https://dbtcharts.pages.dev/docs/guides/dashboard-yaml

Key project files:

- dbt_project.yml: dbt project definition.
- dbt_charts.yml: dbt-charts paths and dashboard config.
- models/: dbt SQL models.
- target/manifest.json: dbt artifact used to resolve ref() and source().
- visualisations/*.ggsql: chart SQL plus visualisation directives.
- dashboards/*.yml: dashboard definitions and chart ordering.
- target/ggsql/: generated compiled SQL, chart artifacts, dashboards, and exported site.

Scaffold workflow:

```bash
dbt-charts init
dbt-charts init --clean
```

Use init from a dbt project root. It creates dbt_charts.yml when missing, creates visualisations/ and dashboards/, writes a starter .ggsql file, and writes a starter dashboard YAML file. Use --clean only when replacing the starter chart/dashboard files selected by the prompts.

Core workflow:

```bash
dbt build
dbt-charts doctor
dbt-charts validate
dbt-charts render
dbt-charts dashboard
dbt-charts export
```

When running from outside the dbt project, pass:

```bash
dbt-charts validate --project-dir path/to/dbt_project
```

Assistant workflow:

1. If visualisations/ or dashboards/ are missing, suggest dbt-charts init or run it when the user asks for scaffolding.
2. Read dbt_project.yml, dbt_charts.yml, models/, target/manifest.json, visualisations/, and dashboards/.
3. Create or update a .ggsql file under visualisations/.
4. Add the chart name to the relevant dashboard YAML under dashboards/.
5. Run dbt-charts doctor, validate, render, and dashboard.
6. Report changed files, validation results, generated artifacts, and anything requiring human review.

Guardrails for agents:

- Do not edit dbt models unless the user asks for model changes.
- Use only supported dbt-charts .ggsql directives and chart types.
- Keep chart SQL close to dbt model names and existing project conventions.
- Preserve dashboard YAML unless the requested change requires an update.
- Explain unresolved refs, missing target/manifest.json, missing chart files, and DuckDB execution errors directly.
